# Mr. Barbosa Mens Hair Salon

> A one-on-one men's grooming studio on the Chelsea / Flatiron border in NYC. Precision haircuts, classic beard work, and a calm, sophisticated experience designed for the modern gentleman.

## About

- **Owner / Stylist:** Igor Barbosa
- **Established:** 2014
- **Experience:** Over a decade of men's grooming
- **Format:** Single-chair studio, by appointment only
- **Address:** 124 W 24th St, Suite 8, New York, NY 10011
- **Neighborhood:** Chelsea / Flatiron border, Manhattan (West 24th between 6th and 7th Avenues)
- **Website:** https://mrbarbosamenshair.com
- **Booking:** https://www.vagaro.com/mrbarbosa/services
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/barbosasalonnyc/

## Hours

- Monday: Closed
- Tuesday – Friday: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- Saturday: 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed

## Services

### Haircuts
- **Men's Haircut** — Consultation, wash, precision cut, and finishing style. Tailored to face shape and lifestyle.
- **Buzz Cut** — Clean, even all-over clipper cut with detailed neckline and hairline.
- **Kids Haircut** — Patient, age-appropriate cuts for younger clients.

### Beard Services
- **Classic Beard Trim** — Scissor-driven shaping for natural texture, with cheek and neckline detail.
- **Men's Haircut & Classic Beard Trim** — The full grooming package: precision cut + scissor-shaped beard trim in one visit.

### Specialty
- **Scalp & Neck Massage** — Therapeutic add-on to relieve tension and round out the visit.

## What Makes Mr. Barbosa Different

- **One client at a time.** A single-chair studio means no rushed appointments, no noisy floor.
- **Real consultation.** Every visit starts with a conversation about your hair, routine, and goals.
- **Scissor-driven beard work** for natural texture instead of an over-uniform clipper finish.
- **Modern + classic.** Precision fades and modern cuts informed by the discipline of a classic men's atelier.
- **Decade of practice.** Igor has spent over ten years refining the craft.

## Booking

All appointments are booked online via Vagaro: https://www.vagaro.com/mrbarbosa/services

Mr. Barbosa does not accept walk-ins.

## Areas Served

Based on the Chelsea / Flatiron border, walking or train distance from:
- Chelsea (10001, 10011)
- Flatiron / NoMad / Gramercy
- Meatpacking District / West Village
- Hudson Yards / Hell's Kitchen
- All of central Manhattan via the 23rd St 1/F/M/R/W stations
